title: Published PUBLIC_CUSTOMER policy and knowledge bundle
description: The only content a public agent runtime may state to a customer. Resolved by active bundle hash through an allowlist, never by post-retrieval filtering. An expired bundle degrades the agent to REQUIRE_HUMAN; it never falls back to an older version.

version.description: Monotonic. A corrected bundle is a new version; an existing version is never edited.

audience.description: INTERNAL_OPERATIONS, INTERNAL_RISK and DRAFT content can never appear in this contract, which is why the public allowlist is keyed on it.

lifecycle.description: Only PUBLISHED within its effective period is active. WITHDRAWN takes effect immediately and needs no re-approval.

effective_until.description: Null means open-ended. Time-bounded content such as a promotion must set this to the exact published end date.

content_sha256.description: Recorded on every outbound message derived from this bundle, so a correction can identify the affected set.

authorized_capabilities.description: Listing a capability here grants no authorization. The capability still requires its own signed gate manifest.

kind.description: LIABILITY, COMPENSATION and REWASH are deliberately absent. They depend on DEC-004 and must not be publishable until it resolves.

source.description: No other provenance is publishable. Internal risk material has no admissible source value by construction.

deterministic_check.description: Required for LIST_PRICE, PROMOTION, DELIVERY_ZONE and TURNAROUND facts.

matched.description: The fact was re-derived from the engine and matched exactly. A price the engine does not produce, including a smoothed tier boundary, fails publication.

prohibited_content_scan.description: Fail-closed. An unclassifiable fact is rejected; ambiguity is never resolved toward publication.

legal_review.description: NOT_REQUIRED is legal only when the bundle contains no liability, compensation, data-processing or contractual terms.

open_decisions_excluded.description: Open decisions the scan confirmed are not asserted anywhere in this bundle.

approved_by.description: The business owner. Approval of a hash whose contents were not read is not approval.

approved_content_sha256.description: Must equal content_sha256. A mismatch means the bundle changed after approval and is invalid.

supersedes.description: Version this bundle corrects, when published through the correction workflow.
